_doc: Canon database. Sourced from CRITTER Master Lore Bible v12 + approved model sheets. Do not edit without Lead sign-off. 'art' records the approved model sheet each sprite/portrait is cut from.

aruun.name: Aruun
aruun.title: The Reacher
aruun.contradiction: He is famous for destruction and wants to be remembered for building.

cigarra.name: Cigarra
cigarra.title: The Oracle Hopper
cigarra.quote: Reality is just someone else's memory.
cigarra.contradiction: She can glimpse possibilities but struggles to trust certainty.

nerit.name: Nerit
nerit.title: The Lumen Weaver
nerit.contradiction: Nerit creates visibility while believing some things deserve darkness.

mollusk.name: Mollusk
mollusk.title: The Weight of Tomorrow
mollusk.quote: Some things don't break... they just take longer.
mollusk.contradiction: He can delay consequences but believes consequences must eventually be faced.

zephyr.name: Zephyr
zephyr.title: The Nectar Seeker
zephyr.contradiction: Zephyr treats rules as games but treats promises as sacred.

nyxaris.name: Nyxaris
nyxaris.title: The Frostbloom Weaver
nyxaris.quote: She lures with beauty... and keeps you forever.
nyxaris.contradiction: She creates beautiful things specifically to control danger.

pharilux.name: Pharilux
pharilux.title: The Watcher Below
pharilux.quote: Even in darkness, someone keeps watch.
pharilux.contradiction: He guides others while refusing to explain where he came from.

scarlith.name: Scarlith
scarlith.title: The Fermented Kingpin
scarlith.contradiction: He believes everything has value and therefore risks treating everything as merchandise.

solmara.name: Solmara
solmara.title: The Tide Balancer
solmara.quote: The ocean remembers both the sun and the moon.
solmara.contradiction: Solmara understands enormous celestial systems but can misread individual emotion.

bramvex.name: Bramvex
bramvex.title: The Quiet Command
bramvex.knack: Camouflage / Sensory Adaptation / Tactical Terrain Use
bramvex.contradiction: A professional soldier who distrusts anyone eager for war.

mara.name: Dr. Mara Venn
mara.title: Lead Physicist — Expedition Lead
mara.quote: Curiosity always wins. It just usually costs more than people expect.

art.sheet: bible media image17.jpg (illustrated — approved for game)

dexter.name: Dexter Mane
dexter.title: Director — Human Dominion
dexter.quote: Morality is a luxury. So is time.

aruun_combo.name: Morrow
aruun_combo.desc: A three-strike mace combo. The last swing knocks enemies back.

reaching_strike.name: Reaching Strike
reaching_strike.desc: Morrow extends through the psionic link for a devastating long-range hit. Shatters cracked Thoughtstone.

gravity_pull.name: Gravity Pull
gravity_pull.desc: Morrow floats ahead, drags enemies together, then slams down.

beetle_rage.name: Beetle Rage
beetle_rage.desc: Deliberate physiological overdrive. Greater strength, paid for with Aruun's own body (Strain).

bad_thought.name: Bad Thought
bad_thought.desc: Flicks a crown sphere and fires a distorted psychic object.

premonition.name: Premonition
premonition.desc: Translucent future ghosts show where enemies are about to move or attack. Dodge through one to counter.

false_memory.name: False Memory
false_memory.desc: A temporary hallucination. Enemies believe it and attack it.

brain_skip.name: Brain Skip
brain_skip.desc: The target loses a fraction of time. Its action jumps forward and it stumbles.

grasshopper_thought.name: Grasshopper Thought
grasshopper_thought.desc: Crouch low, then launch great distances. The wing cloak opens for steering.

probable_impact.name: Probable Impact
probable_impact.desc: While Premonition is active, Gravity Pull's slam lands where Cigarra saw it would: double damage and a stun.

terrarium_one.name: Terrarium One
terrarium_one.desc: It began as a laboratory containing ecosystems. It became an ecosystem containing laboratories.

the_common.name: The Common
the_common.desc: The first genuinely mixed district. No architect designed it. Aruun later helped prevent it from collapsing.

red_reaches.name: The Red Reaches
red_reaches.desc: Plateaus, mineral deserts and enormous fracture valleys. Settlements survive because generations maintain bridges, wells and roads.

ochre_span.name: The Ochre Span
ochre_span.desc: A Spanwright crossing older than anyone's records, built in the same tradition as the Red Span that failed.

skitter_mite.name: Skitter Mite
skitter_mite.desc: Rust-red mites that strip mineral crust from rock. Harmless alone. Not alone, usually.
skitter_mite.behavior: Swarms. Flees when its swarm is broken.

plate_beetle.name: Plate Beetle
plate_beetle.desc: A slow, heavy grazer of mineral lichen with a carapace like layered slate.
plate_beetle.behavior: Normally docile. Agitated by resonance vibration — the Dominion pylons are driving it mad.

dust_grazer.name: Dust Grazer
dust_grazer.desc: Long-legged lichen grazers. Their droppings seed the lichen that holds the plateau soil together.
dust_grazer.behavior: Passive. Ecological keystone — harming the herd destabilizes the valley.

dominion_drone.name: Survey Drone (Dominion)
dominion_drone.desc: Autonomous survey and security drone licensed under a Dominion extraction permit.
dominion_drone.behavior: Defends the drill site. Weak to heavy impact.

augur_rig.name: AUGUR-7 Deepcore Rig
augur_rig.desc: A Thoughtstone extraction rig. Its drill is resonating with the Span's foundation.
augur_rig.behavior: Vents coolant when overheated — the vents are its weakness.
